title: Two Gemini masterminds spent about $17 of OpenRouter money in 20 minutes, reading and never acting
area: Servex/agents/Agents.js (cost counted only after a turn), Servex/ext/openrouter/provider.js
fix: Spend follows results (the owner's rule): Agents.js prices every OpenRouter call as it settles; a work agent gets $2 for its first result (a commit, a step done, a page line, a minion with a brief), and each result unlocks $3 more up to the brief's Budget (else $20); with no result by then, Servex interrupts it between tool calls and posts one Inbox card (Continue +$5 / Stop). A warning at 40 reads without a result. Live after a Servex restart; tests are token-reduction item 4. Accounting check: ai/2026-10-02/servex-mastermind/or-reconcile.mjs

reports.evidence: mastermind-ai-2 and mastermind-page-2 (google/gemini-3.8-flash) took OpenRouter usage from $12.69 to $29.92 in about 20 minutes and spawned nothing. ai-2: 149 model calls, 134 Read calls, 1.4M input + 9.2M cache read + 9.2M cache creation tokens, an empty result. page-2: 148 Reads. Servex showed ai-2 at $13.36. Both were stopped, and the burst was lowered to +$10

a likely root cause: ~10.6M input tokens each at $0.75/M is ~$8 per agent, and ~$17 was charged for both, so it looks like no cache discount, though the SDK reported 9.2M cache-read tokens. To check: or-reconcile.mjs (per-request cached tokens, discount, upstream) and or-cache-probe.mjs (five routes)

title: The prompt refiner refined its own model calls, and each one started more claude processes
fix: Echo.js now records the session id of each of its own model calls and drops prompts from them, refuses a 5th live echo agent, and checks the 4 GB floor before each call (live after a Servex restart). Server/ask-each.mjs marks every askOnce session LEW42_NO_RELAY. The hooks learn the same rule (SDK sessions are never the owner) through ai/2026-10-02/servex-mastermind/apply-echo-gate.mjs (.claude/ is refused to -10; takes effect at once)

reports.evidence: Servex (pid 79392) started 16 claude SDK processes between 22:17 and 22:21 (~4.2 GB), most without --resume, while /agents showed 3 working; 1.4 GB free

the cause in code: Echo.process() -> clean()/structure() -> askOnce() starts an SDK session inside Servex, whose env has no SERVEX_MCP; prompt-relay.mjs took it for the owner and posted it to /log/echo; a new session id meant a new echo agent and another clean()

title: The always-on Servex mastermind stayed down after its process died
fix: Global.keep_on(), on the one-minute sweep: if the holder has no live or dormant agent, reopen it and tell it to resume from its task log (at most 3 restarts in 30 minutes). The holder's revive now passes force, so a 'landed' task log naming it can't block it; only a deleted cwd does

reports.evidence: VS Code crashed at about 22:30 and took most claude processes with it; mastermind-servex-10 did not come back until it was resumed by hand
a dead process ends Agent.pump(), which sets state 'stopped' with no stopped_by; only a message (send -> wake) or a Servex boot reopened it, and nothing watched it
